name: register_repo_root
description: Tell the session that a repo attached via add_repo has finished cloning, so its CLAUDE.md, skills, and plugins load on the next turn. Only call immediately after a successful clone that add_repo instructed you to run — it returns a tool error for a repo that is not already in this session's sources.

owner.description: GitHub owner of the repo that was just cloned (same value passed to add_repo).

repo.description: GitHub repo name that was just cloned (same value passed to add_repo).

directory.description: Absolute path of the clone on disk.
